items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
MOTION TO OVERRIDE VETO BY GOVERNOR

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to full day kindergarten
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S700

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the education law, in relation to
full day kindergarten

 PURPOSE OF THE BILL :

This bill expands the full day kindergarten conversion aid to a five
year transition program.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section one of the bill amends section 3602 of the education law as it
relates to expanded full day kindergarten conversion aid. The enhanced
incentive will provide school districts that have half day or no
kindergarten programs in the 2015-16 school year with funding over a
five year period to transition to full day. The aid would be equal to
the current conversion aid in the first year, 80% of the aid in year
two, 60% of the aid in year three, 40% of the aid in year four and 20%
of the aid in year five.

Section two of the bill relates to the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

There are only a handful of school districts in New York that have
half day kindergarten programs. This legislation would assist those
school districts in transitioning to full day kindergarten by
expanding the current incentive aid program to be spread out over five
years. This bill will help New York move closer to providing full day
kindergarten to all students in the State regardless of where they
live.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2015-16: S7070B/A8692B - Education/passed assembly

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE :

It is estimated that the legislation will cost $37 million if all
eligi- ble school districts utilized the transition aid which includes
the estimated $12 million under the current conversion formula.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 263
 
TO THE SENATE:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:
 
Senate Bill Number 700-B, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to amend the education law, in relation to full day kinder-
      garten"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  This bill would amend the New York State Education Law to provide five
years of transitional aid to school districts transition  from  offering
half-day or no kindergarten programs to offering full day kindergarten.
 
  The  legislature passed this bill in March, one month before I reached
agreement to include in the fiscal year 2019 State budget three-years of
transition aid to school districts that begin offering full day  kinder-
garten  in 2018-19 and 2019-20. Because this issue has been addressed in
the recently enacted State budget, this bill is effectively moot.
 
  I fully agree with the purpose of this bill and  have  worked  persis-
tently  to expand both pre-kindergarten and full day kindergarten in New
York State. Only five school districts in New York  State  currently  do
not offer full day kindergarten. The agreement reached in the 2019 State
budget  will  further incentivize the expansion of full day kindergarten
in these districts.
 
  Given the agreement that was reached with the Legislature  to  address
this  issue in the recently passed state budget, and the increase in aid
that will now be provided to districts to transition to full day kinder-
garten, this legislation is unnecessary. Therefore, I  am  compelled  to
veto this bill.
 
  The bill is disapproved.                    (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
 
                               __________
